description: List the languages InDesign knows with their spelling, hyphenation and thesaurus vendors (such as Hunspell, Proximity or Duden), quotation marks and dictionary paths, or set a language's vendors, double and single quotes, and add or remove Hunspell dictionary folders (Preferences > Dictionary)

action.description: list languages, or set one language's options

addDictionaryPath.description: For set: a folder of Hunspell dictionary files to add for the language

doubleQuotes.description: For set: opening and closing double quotes, two characters such as "“”"

hyphenationVendor.description: For set: hyphenation vendor, one of the language's hyphenationVendorList (e.g. "Duden")

nameContains.description: For list: only languages whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

removeDictionaryPath.description: For set: a dictionary folder to remove

singleQuotes.description: For set: opening and closing single quotes, two characters

spellingVendor.description: For set: spelling vendor, one of the language's spellingVendorList (e.g. "Hunspell")

name: manage_languages
title: Manage Languages
